scope: All 101 local projects:12 originals +89 generated adventures. Includes shipped and unreleased; current local source is evidence, not proof of live deployment.
method: Independent source review of every game.json, catalogue definitions, deterministic challenge branches, activity implementations, shared success/progression, and original gameplay systems. Fingerprints compare child action→state→consequence→replay, not art/theme names or shared engines.
limitations: No fresh browser/physical-device/child/educator play. Prior sandbox evidence reported blocked browser IPC; no new enjoyment claims.
No assumption which first 5–6 games user kids liked. Original status is not immunity and retained candidates are not approved quality.
A different educational concept is credited as such, but content variety alone does not justify separate games.
Rework means concept salvage through substantial redesign; it is not a recommendation to keep shipping the current game.
No files/resources are deleted or released by this judge. Removal is a coordinator decision after independent judge synthesis and deployment inventory.
cross_catalogue_findings: 89 generated projects route into 26 mode branches, but counting modes is insufficient: match variants/arithmetic operations/Tangram/Snowflake show real distinctions.

Strong exact-duplicate families are 4 path games,3 balances,4 picture-pattern games,4 mixes,3 standard mirrors,2 quarter-turn keys,2 builds,2 rhythms,2 pitches; these claims follow identical controls/predicates, not only shared code.
Most generated rounds have one prescribed answer then explicit Next, five rounds then shared completion. Only selected modes expose free composition/building; created state is round-local.
Originals combine action with changing consequences, mastery, creation, discovery, persistent artifacts or social play. Their similarity in theme/input does not erase those differences.
Repeated source/technical checks and polished models cannot establish fun. The large queue should remain stopped during curation.
